dedupe_keys.name: real world sensor dataset for city inbound outbound critical intersection analysis

description: Real-world sensor dataset for city inbound-outbound critical intersection analysis is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ei Ei Mon et al. This paper reports the release of dataset that describes the critical city inbound-outbound intersection in the central business district’s Sathorn area of Bangkok, Thailand. The available traffic volume and occupancy are captured by sensors located on the Sathorn area’s links. Coverage: global (TH); published in 2022. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 365379186 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
